{'text': '身家時而突破萬億美元嘅馬斯克（Elon Musk）星期四就一宗集體訴訟達成和解。該訴訟指控佢嘅政治行動委員會喺2024年總統大選中涉嫌欺詐，呃選民話佢哋有機會隨機贏走100萬美元，但實際上中獎者係預先選定嘅。', 'paragraph_context': 'Intermittent trillionaire Elon Musk settled a class action lawsuit Thursday over allegations that his political action committee engaged in fraud in the 2024 presidential election by falsely telling voters they had a chance to randomly win $1 million when the winners were actually predetermined.'}

{'text': '根據網上法庭紀錄，一份只有一頁嘅文件寫道：「各方已達成和解協議，並謹請法庭撤銷所有期限，暫停進一步訴訟程序，為期三十（30）日，以便各方完成並簽署和解協議，以及提交初步批准動議。」', 'paragraph_context': '“The Parties have reached a Settlement and respectfully request that the Court vacate all deadlines and stay further proceedings for a period of thirty (30) days to allow the Parties to finalize and execute the settlement agreement and file a Motion for Preliminary Approval,” a one-page filing reads, according to online court records.'}

{'text': '為咗幫特朗普（Donald Trump）當選總統，馬斯克喺大選前一個月成立咗America PAC呢個委員會。佢透過呢個政治行動委員會，喺幾個關鍵搖擺州份同特朗普支持者講，只要佢哋交出個人身份資料並喺網上簽署一份支持「言論自由及擁槍權」嘅請願書，就有機會贏走100萬美元。', 'paragraph_context': 'As part of an effort to get President Donald Trump elected, Musk set up the committee ― America PAC ― a month before the election. Using his PAC, Musk told Trump supporters in key battleground states they had a chance to win $1 million if they gave away their personal identifying information and signed an online petition in support of “free speech and the right to bear arms.”'}

{'text': '費城地區檢察官Larry Krasner入禀法院指控馬斯克經營非法抽獎計劃，但賓夕凡尼亞州一名法官批准繼續派獎，因為馬斯克委員會嘅律師成功爭辯指，呢個活動實際上唔算抽獎，中獎者係根據佢哋「適合與否」獲選擔任委員會嘅代言人，而100萬美元其實係佢哋嘅酬勞。', 'paragraph_context': 'While Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner went to court to accuse Musk of running an illegal lottery scheme, a Pennsylvania judge allowed the payouts to continue after attorneys for Musk’s PAC successfully argued that it wasn’t actually a lottery because winners were selected “based on their suitability” to serve as spokespeople for the PAC and had earned the $1 million as payment.'}

{'text': '因此，雖然馬斯克向十幾名中獎者派發咗數百萬美元，但冇一個係隨機抽中嘅。', 'paragraph_context': 'So while Musk doled out millions to more than a dozen winners, none of them were randomly selected.'}

{'text': '大選結束後幾日內，馬斯克遭多人提起訴訟。嚟自亞利桑那州嘅Joy Havrick喺訴狀中指自己被當成「宣傳工具」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Multiple lawsuits were filed against Musk in the days after the election. Joy Havrick of Arizona alleged in a complaint that she was treated as a “marketing prop.”'}

{'text': '訴狀寫道：「如果原告知道呢個抽獎並非隨機，或者佢根本冇公平機會贏到獎金，又或者佢嘅入選係取決於被告覺得佢適合作為宣傳工具嘅程度，咁佢就唔會簽署或支持America PAC嘅請願書，亦唔會將自己嘅個人識別資訊（PII）交畀被告。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Had Plaintiff been aware that the lottery was not random, or that she did not have a fair chance to win the prize, or that her selection hinged on her perceived favorability to Defendants as a marketing prop, she would not have signed or supported the America PAC petition and would not have provided her PII [Personal Identifying Information] to Defendants,” the complaint said.'}

{'text': '代表Havrick嘅律師Mark Bankston過往曾代表桑迪胡槍擊案死難者家屬，並成功就誹謗罪起訴陰謀論者Alex Jones。佢接受《HuffPost》訪問時話「暫時未能置評」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Attorney Mark Bankston, who has previously represented Sandy Hook families and successfully sued conspiracy theorist Alex Jones for defamation, represents Havrick. Bankston told HuffPost he is “unable to comment at this time.”'}

{'text': '和解協議嘅細節，包括馬斯克最終須支付幾多錢，目前未有公布。', 'paragraph_context': 'Details of the settlement, including how much Musk will ultimately have to pay, were not immediately disclosed.'}

{'text': '馬斯克嘅代表律師未有即時回應查詢。', 'paragraph_context': 'A lawyer for Musk did not immediately respond to a request for comment.'}
